services.name: Bond cleaning
services.h1: Bond cleaning that covers the inspection detail.
services.intro: Moving out of a rental? Our bond cleaning is a detailed end-of-lease clean designed around the areas agents commonly check — kitchens, bathrooms, floors, tracks and the oven — so you can hand the keys back without spending your last days scrubbing.
body: We work through vacant houses, units and townhouses across Brisbane and the Gold Coast. The quote is based on the property in front of us, not a one-size package that leaves extras to guesswork.

Cleaning can include kitchens and bathrooms, cooktop and rangehood, cupboards and drawers, bedrooms and living areas, skirting boards, doors and frames, floors, accessible internal windows, tracks and sills, and the oven.
If something we cleaned is flagged after the job, send us the inspection notes. Where the miss is ours, we will arrange a reclean.
why: Detailed, not rushed
We work through the property methodically so tracks, skirtings and corners get the same care as benchtops.
Clear quote first
You know what is included before we start. The price is based on your layout, not a surprise on the day.
Built for move-out
The job is organised around handover, vacant access and the rooms an inspection usually covers.
faqs: What is bond cleaning?
Bond cleaning, also called end of lease cleaning, is a detailed clean of a rental when a tenant moves out. It is designed to cover areas typically checked at inspection.
What does it include?
Kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, living areas and floors, including skirting boards, window tracks and oven cleaning. Exact inclusions depend on the property and your quote.
Do I need to be moved out?
It helps to have belongings out so we can reach every surface. Tell us if some furniture will still be there.
How do I get a price?
Request a quote with the property type, bedrooms, suburb and preferred date, or call 0422 555 984.

services.name: Carpet steam cleaning
services.h1: Carpet steam cleaning that lifts the dull, not just the surface.
services.intro: Professional extraction cleaning for homes, rentals, offices and Airbnb stays. We use professional equipment to pull out accumulated dirt and leave carpets looking and smelling fresher.
body: Tell us the rooms, any stains and whether the carpets sit with a bond clean or as their own visit so the quote matches the work.
Stain-removal results depend on the carpet material, age, condition and type of staining. We are upfront about that when we quote.
Suitable for houses, units, investment properties and commercial floor areas that need a proper extraction, not a quick spray.
why: Extraction, not a wipe
Steam extraction is aimed at dirt sitting in the pile, not just the look of a surface tidy.
Quoted to the rooms
You tell us how many rooms and any problem areas. We do not hide extras in the fine print.
Fits around other work
Carpets can sit with a bond clean or be booked on their own — we organise the sequence with you.
faqs: Do you steam-clean carpets?
Yes. Carpet steam cleaning is a listed service. Tell us the rooms and any stains when you enquire.
How long until we can walk on them?
Timing depends on the carpet and airflow. We confirm drying notes with your booking.
Can carpets be added to a bond clean?
Yes. Ask when you request the quote so both jobs are planned together.
Will every stain come out?
It depends on the fibre, age and stain type. We discuss realistic results before we start.

services.name: Spring cleaning
services.h1: Spring cleaning charged by the hour, directed by you.
services.intro: Spring cleaning is billed at an hourly rate so you choose how much time you need and which rooms to prioritise — a reset when a regular tidy is no longer enough.
body: Unlike package services, you set the hours and the order of rooms. Our team works through your list during the booked time.
Cleaning can include kitchens, bathrooms, dusting and wiping, bedrooms and living areas, vacuuming and mopping, skirtings, doors and frames, and accessible windows and tracks.
Final cost depends on hours, how many cleaners, property condition and the tasks you request. Ovens, carpets and other specialised extras are quoted separately.
why: You set the hours
Pay for the time you actually want, instead of a fixed package that may not match the house.
Priority rooms first
Tell us what matters most. We start there so the booked time is not wasted on the wrong list.
Easy to book
Share the suburb, a rough hour count and a date. We confirm a clear hourly quote.
faqs: Is spring cleaning hourly?
Yes. It is charged at an hourly rate so you can choose how much time you need.
What if we run out of time?
Completion depends on the hours booked and the condition of the property. Give us your priority rooms when you book.
Can I add an oven or carpets?
Yes. Those are specialised extras and are quoted separately from the hourly clean.
Who is it for?
Homeowners and tenants who want a deeper refresh than a weekly tidy, without a full bond-clean package.

services.name: Oven & BBQ cleaning
services.h1: Oven and BBQ cleaning that breaks down the baked-on grease.
services.intro: Detailed cleaning for ovens and barbecues — racks, trays, glass and hotplates — either with a bond clean or as its own visit.
body: Grease and carbon build-up are the jobs most people put off. We take the appliance apart as far as a standard clean allows and restore a presentable finish.
Depending on the appliance, work can include internal surfaces, racks, trays, doors, glass and accessible exteriors.
Useful for rentals at handover, family kitchens and outdoor BBQs that have been left too long.
why: Built-up grease is the job
We focus on the interior that a wipe never reaches, not just the door glass.
Booked on its own or with a bond clean
Add it to a move-out clean or book a dedicated oven and BBQ visit.
Quoted before we start
Tell us single, double or BBQ so the quote matches the appliance.
faqs: Do you clean BBQs as well as ovens?
Yes. Oven and BBQ cleaning can sit together or run as separate visits.
Do I need to empty the oven?
Remove cookware before we arrive. Trays and racks that belong to the oven can stay.
Can this be added to a bond clean?
Yes. Mention it on the quote form so it is included in the price.
What about rangehoods?
Ask when you enquire. Accessible exteriors and filters can be discussed with the quote.

services.name: Airbnb cleaning
services.h1: Airbnb cleaning that turns the property around between guests.
services.intro: Turnover cleaning for hosts and property managers who need the stay to look ready — not recently vacated — before the next check-in.
body: We work through bedrooms, bathrooms, kitchens, living areas, floors and surfaces to a consistent standard you can repeat.
One-off or recurring turnarounds can be organised around your booking calendar.
Tell us linen, consumables and any extra tasks when you quote so the visit matches how you host.
why: Built for turnarounds
The clean is paced for guest changeover, not a once-a-year deep reset.
Same rooms, same standard
Hosts need consistency. We work a repeatable list so each stay starts the same way.
Flexible roster
One-off or recurring — we confirm the timetable when we quote.
faqs: Do you work to check-in times?
Tell us the turnover window when you enquire. We organise the visit around guest times where we can.
Is linen included?
Linen handling depends on what you request. Add it to the quote so it is costed.
Can I book every changeover?
Yes. Recurring Airbnb cleaning can be discussed after the first visit.
What areas do you cover?
Brisbane and the Gold Coast. If the suburb is listed, we can usually quote.

services.name: Deep cleaning
services.short: When regular cleaning is not enough
services.h1: Deep cleaning for properties that need more than a tidy.
services.intro: A heavier clean when dirt, grease and neglect have built up — houses, apartments, pre-event resets and homes that have not had a professional visit in a long time.
body: The work is customised to size, condition and the rooms you want pushed harder than a spring clean hour count.
Ideal before guests, after a long gap between cleans, or when a property needs a proper reset.
We quote after we understand the condition so the time on site matches the job.
why: Condition first
A deep clean is quoted to how the property actually looks, not a generic room count alone.
Detail that a weekly tidy skips
Skirtings, tracks, neglected wet areas and built-up kitchen grease are the point of the visit.
Clear scope
You will know which rooms and tasks are in before we arrive.
faqs: How is this different from spring cleaning?
Spring cleaning is hourly and directed by you. Deep cleaning is quoted as a fuller reset based on condition.
Do I need to be home?
Not always. Tell us about access and pets when you enquire.
Can I combine it with carpets or the oven?
Yes. Ask for those extras on the same quote.
How long does it take?
It depends on size and condition. We confirm timing with the quote.

services.name: Builder cleaning
services.h1: Builder cleaning after the tools leave.
services.intro: Post-construction and renovation cleaning to get dust off surfaces and present the property for inspection, handover, sale or move-in.
body: We can assist with construction dust and general building residue on suitable surfaces.
Suitable for builders, developers, contractors, homeowners and property managers.
Tell us the stage of works and which areas are ready so the visit is not booked too early.
why: Dust is a different job
Builder cleans are about construction residue, not a standard house tidy.
Handover-ready presentation
The aim is a space you can inspect, photograph or occupy without a film of dust.
Quoted to the site
New builds and renovations vary. We quote after we know the size and stage.
faqs: When should we book?
When trades are largely finished and the property can be accessed without wet paint or active cutting.
Do you clean windows?
Accessible internal glass can be included. Confirm heights and extras on the quote.
Is this the same as a bond clean?
No. Builder cleaning is for post-construction dust. Bond cleaning is an end-of-lease inspection clean.
Who can book?
Builders, owners and property managers — whoever is organising handover.

services.name: Upholstery cleaning
services.h1: Upholstery cleaning for sofas, chairs and fabric furniture.
services.intro: Extraction cleaning to lift dirt from suitable fabric furniture and leave it looking and smelling fresher.
body: The material and condition should be assessed before cleaning so the method matches the fabric.
Useful in family homes, rentals and offices where sofas take daily wear.
Tell us how many seats and the fabric type if you know it so the quote is realistic.
why: Fabric first
We check what the piece can take before we start, instead of using one method on every sofa.
Fresher, not just vacuumed
Extraction is aimed at dirt sitting in the fabric, not only the surface dust.
Add it to a house clean
Upholstery can be quoted with a spring or deep clean, or booked on its own.
faqs: Do you clean leather?
Ask when you enquire. Method depends on the material. We will tell you if a piece is not suitable.
How long until we can sit on it?
Drying time depends on fabric and airflow. We confirm that with the booking.
Can you treat stains?
Results depend on the stain and fibre. We discuss what is realistic first.
How is it priced?
Usually by the piece or seat. Send photos or a count when you request a quote.

services.name: Pressure washing
services.h1: Pressure washing for driveways, paths and outdoor surfaces.
services.intro: Restore concrete, paths, patios and selected exterior surfaces by removing dirt, grime and organic build-up.
body: Ideal for driveways, pathways, concrete areas and patios that have gone grey or slippery.
We quote after we know the surface type and size so the pressure is suitable.
Outdoor work depends on water access and weather. We confirm that when we book.
why: Outside needs different kit
Pressure washing is not a mop. We bring the equipment for exterior surfaces.
Quoted to the area
A short path is not a full driveway. The quote follows the square metres in front of us.
Pairs with a house clean
Book it with a bond or spring clean, or as its own outdoor visit.
faqs: What surfaces can you wash?
Driveways, paths, concrete and selected patios. Tell us the surface when you enquire.
Do I need to supply water?
We confirm water access with the booking.
Will it mark the concrete?
We match pressure to the surface. Flag any known damage before we start.
Do you do roofs or heights?
This service is for accessible outdoor surfaces. Heights and specialist work are not assumed in a standard quote.

services.name: Gym cleaning
services.h1: Gym cleaning for floors, equipment and change rooms.
services.intro: Commercial cleaning for gyms that need a presentable floor, wiped equipment and bathrooms that keep up with member traffic.
body: Cleaning can include equipment exteriors, floors, mirrors, reception, bathrooms, change rooms, common areas and high-touch surfaces.
One-off or recurring commercial arrangements can be discussed.
We work around your opening hours where we can so members are not walking through a wet floor at peak time.
why: High-touch is the brief
Handles, benches and change rooms are treated as the job, not an afterthought.
Roster or one-off
Fit-outs, reopenings and weekly cleans can all be quoted.
After-hours where needed
Tell us when the floor is free. We organise the visit around trade.
faqs: Do you clean equipment?
Yes, exteriors and high-touch surfaces as agreed in the quote.
Can you come after close?
Often yes. Confirm hours when you request a quote.
Is this only for large gyms?
No. Smaller studios and training rooms can be quoted too.
How do we start?
Send the suburb, size and whether you need a one-off or a regular roster.

services.name: Office cleaning
services.h1: Office cleaning that keeps the workplace presentable.
services.intro: One-off or recurring cleaning for offices — workstations, meeting rooms, kitchens, bathrooms and common areas.
body: We provide flexible cleaning for workplaces that need a clear after-hours tidy or a one-off reset.
Cleaning can include desks, reception, meeting rooms, kitchens, bathrooms, floors, common areas and high-touch surfaces.
Tell us headcount, days required and access so the quote matches the site.
why: Quoted to the floorplate
A small suite is not a whole level. The price follows the space and frequency.
After-hours friendly
Most offices prefer the clean when staff have left. We plan around access.
One-off or weekly
Fit-outs, end-of-lease offices and regular rosters are all in scope.
faqs: Do you clean kitchens and bathrooms?
Yes, as part of a typical office clean. Confirm inclusions on the quote.
Can we book once only?
Yes. One-off office cleans are available as well as recurring.
Do staff need to clear desks?
A clear desk helps. Tell us how you work so we know what can be moved.
Which suburbs?
Brisbane and the Gold Coast. Call 0422 555 984 if you sit just outside the list.

services.name: Pub & hospitality cleaning
services.h1: Pub and hospitality cleaning after trade.
services.intro: Cleaning for pubs, restaurants, cafés and bars that need dining rooms, floors, bathrooms and bar areas ready for the next service.
body: Schedules can be arranged around your operating hours so the venue is presented before open.
Cleaning can include dining areas, floors, bathrooms, tables and surfaces, bar areas, entrances and other agreed spaces.
One-off deep resets and regular after-trade visits can both be quoted.
why: Built around service times
Hospitality cleans have to finish before doors open. We plan the visit around trade.
Front of house and amenities
Floors, bathrooms and dining surfaces are the rooms guests notice first.
Venue-specific quote
A café is not a late-night pub. The quote follows how you actually operate.
faqs: Can you clean after close?
Yes. After-trade cleaning is the usual pattern. Confirm lock-up and alarm access when you book.
Do you do kitchens?
Kitchen scope depends on the venue. Tell us what you need included.
One-off or regular?
Both. Reopenings, events and weekly rosters can be quoted.
What should we prepare?
Clear the worst of the floor waste if you can. We confirm a short prep list with the booking.

services.name: Retail store cleaning
services.h1: Retail store cleaning before the doors open.
services.intro: Cleaning for shops, showrooms and customer-facing spaces that need floors, counters and fitting rooms looking ready.
body: Work can include floors, counters, fitting rooms, mirrors, entrances, staff areas, bathrooms and high-touch surfaces.
One-off and recurring arrangements are available around trading hours.
Tell us the floor type and whether stock can be moved so the quote is accurate.
why: Customer-facing first
Entrances, floors and counters are prioritised because that is what shoppers see.
Before-open timing
We organise the clean so the store is dry and presentable at opening.
Quoted to the shop
A boutique is not a large format floor. The visit matches the space.
faqs: Will you work around stock?
Yes. Tell us what can be moved. We do not assume we can shift heavy fixtures.
Do you clean fitting rooms and bathrooms?
Yes, when they are part of the agreed scope.
Can we have a weekly clean?
Yes. Recurring retail cleaning can be quoted after we know the hours.
How do we get a price?
Send the suburb, shop size and preferred time — before open or after close.

services.name: Pest control & flea treatment
services.h1: Pest control and flea treatment tailored to the property.
services.intro: Treatment for homes, rentals and end-of-lease jobs where pests or fleas need handling before the next occupant moves in.
body: We inspect first, then treat the rooms that need it. Preparation notes and any follow-up sit with the quote so you know what to expect.
Suitable for houses, investment properties, pet properties and move-out requirements.
Tell us what you have seen and which rooms are affected so the visit is planned properly.
why: Inspect, then treat
We do not guess the rooms. The visit is based on what the property actually needs.
Works with move-out
Pest and flea treatment can sit alongside a bond clean when a rental is turning over.
Clear next steps
Preparation and follow-up are explained with the quote, not after the technician has left.
faqs: Do you treat fleas?
Yes. Flea treatment is part of this service. Mention pets and which rooms are affected when you enquire.
Do I need to leave the property?
It depends on the treatment. We confirm access and re-entry notes with your booking.
Can this be booked with a bond clean?
Yes. Ask us to quote both so the sequence is organised.
How soon can you come?
Tell us the suburb and preferred date. We will confirm what we can book.
